description.value:
You learn the forbidden art of binding deceased souls into prepared vessels. The Actor tracker stores your Unholy Charges and provides a one-click Edo Tensei creator directly on the character sheet.

  • Maximum summon rank by Class Mod level: D, C, B, A, then S.
  • Unholy Charges: 2 / 6 / 9 / 13 / 18. Twice per long rest, a short rest restores charges equal to Class Mod level. A long rest restores half the maximum, and a full rest restores all charges.
  • All Edo Tensei have disadvantage against Fuinjutsu of equal or higher rank. If sealed at 0 HP, reconstruction costs 10 Ryo per maximum HP.
